_README: This is the GENESIS config every node must agree on. 'founders' is the list of testnet founding addresses (each has run {op:'seal_founder'}); 'relay' is the default relay a downloaded node dials. ⚠️ Luca: replace the founders array with the ACTUAL testnet swarm founder addresses before distributing — the single address here is the known founding wallet and is a PLACEHOLDER, not necessarily the full sealed-founder set. This file is NOT secret (no private keys) and ships inside the download; it is NOT served by the relay, so a compromised relay cannot swap the founder set.
